about: Baseline of the loud-failure watcher (loud-check.ps1, check 5): ERROR / FATAL lines of latest.log and WARN lines of the KubeJS logs that were looked at and accepted.

A line whose signature is not here is reported as NEW; an accepted one seen three times as often as its `count` is reported too. KubeJS ERROR lines, handler aborts and summary errors are never baselined.
`signatures`: accepted, each with the reason and the date. A baseline hides what was broken the day it was taken, so the reason says what the line is, not that it is fine.

`defects`: reviewed and deliberately NOT accepted. They stay findings (KNOWN DEFECT) until they are fixed; when one is fixed its entry is deleted. Do not move one into `signatures` to quiet the report.

A signature is the line without clock, thread, numbers of two or more digits, addresses and ids, cut at 200 characters. No entry may carry a player name, a chat line or an address: this file is public.
Add an entry only after reading the line. `loud-check.ps1 -LogsDir <logs> -ProposeBaseline <file>` writes the current list with reason and date empty.

STALE: an entry of either list whose line is absent from two complete boots in a row (the boot checked and the one before it, read from the rotated logs) is reported as `STALE DEFECT` / `STALE ACCEPTED`: delete it. One boot without the line is not enough: a fix can hold for a single boot (the Crust entry). A stale entry is a report line, never a finding.

`"runtime": true` on an entry: the line is printed while the server runs (it depends on a player, the world or the network), not while it loads, so it is not in every boot and is never called stale. The proposal marks latest.log signatures first printed after `Done`; mark a run-time line of the KubeJS logs by hand.

defects.sig: ERROR [crust/configs/]: Failed first-time loading of config file config\Crust\default_game_rules.toml - this is bad!
defects.what: Crust (third party) cannot parse config/Crust/default_game_rules.toml. REGRESSED, not fixed: the pack's copy was repaired in 6d75d234 and loaded cleanly once (boot of 2026-10-11 23:20, the box's clock); during that load Crust saved the file again in its own format (dotted keys with an unquoted ':'), and at the next boot (2026-10-12 03:24) it could not parse what it had written. So the repair holds for one boot after each full sync and the fault is in Crust's own writer, not in the pack's copy: do not repair the file again. The file only lists game-rule defaults for new worlds and has config_enabled = false, so the line changes nothing in play. Whether to accept it as a known upstream defect is the operator's ruling, still pending: until then it stays here, not in signatures
